crossRefs.note: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.
It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me.

translations.web: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.
translations.bsb: The sleep of the worker is sweet, whether he eats little or much, but the abundance of the rich man permits him no sleep.
translations.kjv: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
translations.asv: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much; but the fulness of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
